title: imap: interop extensions (UNSELECT, ENABLE, LIST-EXTENDED, LIST-STATUS, ID, SEARCHRES)
description:
Implement widely-probed extensions that improve interoperability and reduce round-trips. Clients probe CAPABILITIES and use these when present.

- ENABLE (RFC 5161): explicit capability activation; required to turn on CONDSTORE and QRESYNC. Must be implemented before those extensions.
- UNSELECT (RFC 3691): close the selected mailbox without expunging \Deleted messages; clients use this for cancel-move scenarios.
- LIST-EXTENDED (RFC 5258): LIST with RETURN STATUS option; lets clients get mailbox list and unread counts in a single command.
- LIST-STATUS (RFC 5819): companion to LIST-EXTENDED; batch STATUS responses alongside LIST.
- ID (RFC 2971): client/server identification exchange; many clients (Thunderbird, Apple Mail) send ID unconditionally and expect a response, not an error.
- SEARCHRES (RFC 5182): $ variable saves the last SEARCH result set for use as a UID set in subsequent FETCH/STORE/COPY/MOVE without re-transmitting the list.
